cyber_security_mandates.mandatory_certifications: Mandatory compliance assessment registered on NCA compliance portal; third-party audit for critical systems

incident_disclosure_rules.breach_type: Critical or High Severity Cybersecurity Incident
incident_disclosure_rules.threshold_trigger_definition: NCA ECC Sub-domain 3-3-3: Incidents causing disruption to critical infrastructure, sensitive data leakage, or active cyber intrusion.

recipient_authorities: Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA)
incident_disclosure_rules.threshold_trigger_definition: Breach of personal data resulting in potential harm to data subjects or violation of rights.

sector_applicability.specific_obligations: Generation, transmission, distribution, and pipeline SCADA integrity.
Water treatment, distribution telemetry, and environmental control.
Hospital systems, medical device cybersecurity, and EHR data protection.
Payment systems, banking core networks, and cyber resilience audits.
Public telecommunications networks, submarine cables, and 5G security.
Machinery safety, industrial robotics, PLC programming, and safety instrumented systems.
Rail signaling, air traffic management, maritime port terminals, and connected vehicles.
